'''Dianne Helen Cook''' is an Australian statistician, the former editor of the ''[[Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics]]'',{{r|qa}} and an expert on the [[Data visualization|visualization of high-dimensional data]].{{r|mu}} She is Professor of Business Analytics in the Department of Econometrics and Business Statistics at [[Monash University]]{{r|mu}} and professor emeritus of statistics at [[Iowa State University]].<ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref>{{r|em}} The [[emeritus]] status was chosen so that she could continue to supervise graduate students at Iowa State after moving to Australia.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Cook|first=Di|date=|title=Di Cook|url=http://dicook.org/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170625233020/http://dicook.org:80/ |archive-date=25 June 2017 |access-date=2020-08-24|website=dicook.org|language=en-us}}</ref><ref>[http://visiphilia.org/ Visiphilia: The love of plotting data] (shared blog with [[Heike Hofmann]])</ref><ref name="BujaCook1996">{{cite journal|last1=Buja|first1=Andreas|last2=Cook|first2=Dianne|last3=Swayne|first3=Deborah F.|title=Interactive High-Dimensional Data Visualization|journal=Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics|volume=5|issue=1|year=1996|pages=78–99|issn=1061-8600|doi=10.1080/10618600.1996.10474696}}</ref>

==Education and early life==
Dianne Helen Cook{{r|cv}} grew up in [[Wauchope, New South Wales]] as an athletic farm girl, the first woman to play on her local (men's) [[cricket]] team. She studied statistics at [[University of New England (Australia)]],{{r|qa}} where she earned a [[Bachelor of Science|BSc]] and [[Diploma of Education|Dip.Ed.]] in 1982.{{r|cv}} She received her [[Master of Science|MS]] in 1990 and her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 1993 from [[Rutgers University]]; her dissertation, supervised jointly by Andreas Buja and Javier Cabrera, was ''Grand Tour and Projection Pursuit''.{{r|cv}}{{r|mathgene}}

==Career and research==
Cook joined the [[Iowa State University]] faculty in 1993, and remained there until her move to [[Monash University]] in 2015.{{r|cv}} At Iowa State, her students have included [[Hadley Wickham]] and [[Yihui Xie]].{{r|mathgene}}

She is one of the developers of [[GGobi]], and with [[Deborah F. Swayne]], she is the author of ''Interactive and Dynamic Graphics for Data Analysis: With R and GGobi'' (Springer, 2007).{{r|interactive}}

She is a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].{{r|mu}} She was editor of the ''[[Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics]]'' from 2016 to 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/action/journalInformation?show=editorialBoard&journalCode=ucgs20& |access-date=2023-03-06 |website=Taylor & Francis |language=en}}</ref>
